info.title: Vector Advert Full ERP - Backend API
info.description:
Complete REST API documentation for Vector Advert Full ERP covering Authentication, HR & Employees, Attendance, Overtime, Field Visits, Leave Management, Recruitment, Internships, Clearances, Professional Upgrades, Trainings, Strategic Plans, Ethiopian Payroll & Loans, Multi-Warehouse Inventory & Fixed Assets, GRV, Store Requests & SIV, Procurement, Supplier Credits, File Uploads, and the Universal Evidence Hub.

### Authentication
Obtain a JWT via `POST /api/auth/login`, click **Authorize**, and enter `<token>` (Swagger UI prepends `Bearer `).
